 Bolex Reporter, Volume 17
 1967
 Volume 17, Number 1
 Articles: "Verifying a Discovery", Geza de Rosner; "From Mountain to Desert", Major Mike Banks; "A New Way of Seeing", Peter Vanadia; "Alpine Flight", Robert A. Mickelsen; "Filming Summer Indians", William Holloway; "Focus in on Nature", Daniel Lyons, Peter Fetko and Leonard Rue; "The Neglected Art - Editing", William A. Keith; "Unusual Ski Films", Hans Gmoser; "A Happy Choice of Camera", Mel Baldwin; "Filming in Vietnam", Tony Munday
 The first Bolex super 8mm camera is reviewed in this issue, along with the newest line of super 8 projectors: the SM8 and 18-5 Super. The new H-16 REX-5, with 400 foot magazine and accessories, is also introduced. 
 32 pages
 1967-1968
 Volume 17, Number 2
 Articles: "A Day at the Races", E. Abraben; "An Idea is Born", Carlton Schammel; "The Lens That Does the Impossible", William A. Keith; "Alaskan Adventure", Wolfgang Bayer; "A Trip to the South Pole", John P. Elden; "Nature Walkabout", Vincent Serventy; "A New Amphibian for Maryland", Daniel J. Lyons; "The Sahara is a Woman", Bill Hill; "A Science Documentary at Sea", Willard Bascom; "Educational Television", Rev. Brother Charles Felix, FSC
 The SM8 projector and 150 camera are reviewed again; although both read more like a brochure or advertisement.
 32 pages
